spec.scope: Generic self ATK buff (atkPct) — the 30-normal-attack clause is the TRIGGER accrual, not a scope on the buff itself; buff feeds all of brid's damage while live.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 — wall-clock seconds, explicitly 'for 10 sec'. NOT durationShots. Recurring: hitCount re-fires every 30 rounds and REFRESHES the buff (AR ~30 rounds ≈ 2.5s of firing, so steady-state uptime is near-permanent after the first ~2.5s ramp; the 10s window also bridges the ~1.65s reload at 60 ammo).
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:30 (counts ROUNDS; AR hitsPerShot 1 so rounds == pulls). No FB gate, no burst gate — accrues from t=0 outside any burst state.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Passive always-on from t=0 (skipping the 30-attack accrual), or a once-only trigger whose single 10s window lapses at ~t=12.5s and never returns — either drops the accrual/refresh structure the prose states.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Via cfg.onEvent on controlComp(brid): count brid's 'shot' events before the FIRST buffApply {stat:'atkPct', value:18.52, casterIdx==targetIdx==brid} — must be exactly 30 (no apply at frame 0); then further buffApply events with the same key recur every 30 subsequent shots for the whole fight (refresh), each with expiresFrame ≈ applyFrame + 600. Once-only model fails the recurrence check; passive model fails the first-apply-after-30-shots check.
spec.inertness: No buffApply for this key targets any ally (targetIdx must always equal brid's idx); no application before the 30th round; buff must not be gated on or keyed to Full Burst.

spec.durationSemantics: Instant hit per activation; no duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: NO activation clause in the prose → interval trigger by convention, sec = datamined skillCooldownsSec, first fire at t=sec (not t=0; no 'Forcefully uses' clause). The cadence value itself is ⚑ ALWAYS-FLAG class 2 (damage line with no kit-stated trigger — invented trigger + cadence).

spec.nearestWrongModel: Inventing an attack-linked trigger (hitCount/lastBullet/shotFired) so cadence scales with fire rate and reloads, or granting the hit core (core:true) / range — any of which silently re-couples a fixed-cooldown skill to weapon cadence or over-credits core exposure.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Event log: brid emits 'damage' events with bucket 'skill' and mult consistent with 211.2% at a FIXED interval — timestamps at t=CD, 2·CD, 3·CD… independent of shot count (assert the gap between consecutive skill-bucket instances is constant and does NOT shrink when a buff raises fire uptime); each such event has zero core contribution and rangeApplied false. Under a hitCount misread the inter-hit gap tracks ammo/reload cadence instead — RED.

spec.kitLine: 1440% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage
spec.scope: Burst-bucket damage instance, 1440% of final ATK. Crits at sheet rate; no core; no range bonus; FB-EXEMPT — burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens (measured house rule: no +50%, no entry auras).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant, once per own burst cast. 40s burst cooldown.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (stage 3) — fires ONLY on rotations BRID herself casts. NOT fullBurstEnter: the control fixture carries helm as a co-B3, so a fullBurstEnter keying would fire this nuke on helm's rotations too — the canonical burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter over-credit.
spec.targetSet: enemy ('highest final DEF' — the single boss)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter (fires on EVERY team Full Burst including helm's rotations, roughly doubling proc count in the control comp) and/or left FB-eligible so it collects the +50% Full-Burst major it can never see in-game.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On controlComp(brid) (helm co-B3 present): the number of brid burst-bucket 'damage' instances at 1440% === the number of burstCast events whose caster is brid (strictly fewer than total fullBurstStart events when helm takes rotations), and every such event has inFullBurst false / fbMajorApplied false. RED under fullBurstEnter keying (count matches fullBurstStart count) and RED under FB-major application.

spec.kitLine: same target at Max HP: 1440% additional
spec.scope: Additional 1440% function damage, gated on the ENEMY being at Max HP ('Affects the same target when at Max HP' — the condition attaches to the target clause, i.e. an untouched-enemy opener bonus).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant conditional rider per own burst cast.
spec.triggerIdentity: Same burstCast as the main hit, but condition-gated on target-at-Max-HP. At scope lock the boss stops being at Max HP within the first frames of the fight (all 5 units fire from t=0) and brid's first cast is seconds later, so the gate is NEVER satisfied in any real comp — the line is effectively inert. The effect schema has no enemy-HP gate, so the correct treatment is an unmodeled-verbatim entry plus an inertness pin, not a modeled block.
spec.nearestWrongModel: TWO plausible misreads, both over-crediting: (a) dropping the condition entirely → every cast deals 2880% (2× the burst bucket); (b) reading 'at Max HP' as SELF-at-Max-HP — at scope lock nobody ever takes damage, so a self-HP reading is ALWAYS true and silently reproduces misread (a). The target clause says 'the same target', so the HP condition belongs to the enemy.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Per brid burst cast, exactly ONE 1440%-class burst/function damage instance is emitted — sum brid's burst-cast-frame damage events and assert single-instance magnitude (≈1440%, not ≈2880%). Any always-on encoding of the rider doubles the per-cast total — RED.
spec.inertness: Brid's per-cast burst damage must equal the single 1440% hit; total damage must not move if this line's text is present vs absent from the override.

notes: Three expected shared-prior traps to reconcile against the driver. (1) The burst Max-HP rider: any reading that makes it live — always-on, or self-HP-gated (trivially true at scope lock where nobody takes damage) — doubles brid's burst bucket to 2880%; the literal target clause pins the condition to the ENEMY, and the boss leaves Max HP within the opening frames, so the faithful model is effectively inert and belongs in unmodeled with a single-instance-per-cast inertness pin. (2) The burst nuke must be burstCast-keyed, not fullBurstEnter — the control fixture's helm co-B3 makes these genuinely divergent, and it must stay FB-exempt (pre-FB landing). (3) skill2 has NO kit-stated trigger: interval per convention with the cadence a ⚑ from datamined skillCooldownsSec (first fire t=CD); tests should assert fixed-interval cadence decoupled from fire rate rather than pin an unverified CD magnitude. Base-stat sanity: AR/60 ammo/hitsPerShot 1 means 'normal attacks' == rounds == pulls, so skill1's counter has no pellet/multi-hit ambiguity; 30 rounds ≈ 2.5s of firing, so the 10s buff is near-permanent at steady state — the discriminating structure is first-apply-after-30-shots and per-30-shot refresh, not uptime.
